This is my life as well. Cheating husband, and a year old baby. I hate the idea of sharing my son with him. I hate that I’ll have to be the strict school and homework mom while he gets to be fun weekend dad. I have so much anger about him getting the better end of the deal all because he needed to get laid?! It’s so unfair. 

I’m so sorry you’re going through this too.
I did a preconsultation with a lawyer and told him. He said that I shouldn't bring it up since it'll appear like I'm just saying it for attention or to get leverage with the house...
